In the real Linux kernel code, pts_sb_from_inode() uses the dereferenced inode value to check 'inode->i_sb->s_magic == DEVPTS_SUPER_MAGIC' and return the superblock. The simplified file stripped those subsequent uses of x. This dead store is a simplification artifact. The known bug (UninitializedVariable: driver_data uninitialized when ptmx_open takes the error path) is a separate issue.
